# telnyx_rcs_agents (Data Source)

Lists rcs agents, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_rcs_agent`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `brand_id` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `rcs_agents` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rcs_agents))
